description: View a post and all its replies as a conversation thread. Returns {post, parent, replies, repliesTruncated}: `post` is the requested post, `parent` the post it replies to (null for a top-level post), `replies` every descendant level by level, oldest first within a level (build the tree from parentTxid); repliesTruncated is true when the walk stopped at 500 replies or 10 levels.
name: peck_thread
